goal: Attack the single open R50A progress/coverage obligation by exact structural classification of any state for which R33 and the R49H direct token lane are closed, while simultaneously searching for an explicit replayable R50A deadcore. This gate is a theorem-miner and falsifier, not a theorem claim.

conditions: R33 is at a fixed STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE state
no current pivot has an R49H theorem-authorized exact-DP operational token
every current pivot has been passed through the exact R47J fixpoint candidate construction
every constructed R47J candidate has passed independent replay and the existing DP/envelope integrity checks
no pivot yields a terminal or a no-fresh-variable strict-variable-descent successor of persisted width <= 4
target_deadcore_definition.meaning: A witness refutes only universal progress of the current R50A machine. It does not refute other proof systems or algorithms.

corpora.frozen_roots: R49I collect_roots(): center control plus first 64 one-swap reachable fixpoints, deduplicated to exactly 52 roots
corpora.r50a_policy_trace: For each frozen root in the assigned shard, follow exact R50A transitions and inspect every encountered persisted W4 state until terminal or OPEN_OBSTRUCTION.
corpora.safe_only_hard_frontier: For each frozen root in the assigned shard, run the exact R49K pure/safe-DP chain to its first no-R49H-pivot obstruction, if one exists, and classify that explicit reachable hard state with all R47J pivots.
corpora.sharding: Four deterministic shards by root index modulo 4. Sharding changes transport only, never selection or proof authority.

per_pivot: bad retained pair count with union size >= 5
distinct parent clauses participating in bad pairs
exact_cross_pair_measurements.mechanical_local_implication: For a bipolar pivot, chi_star >= 5 implies at least one retained non-tautological cross-pair with union size >= 5, by the definition of chi_star.
exact_cross_pair_measurements.double_count_seed: If every current variable is bipolar and has chi_star >= 5, then the sum of per-variable bad-pair counts is at least the number of current variables. R50B measures reuse/overlap to search for a stronger reachable-state upper bound; it does not assume such an upper bound.

minimality_protocol_if_deadcore_found.accept_deletion_only_if: the reduced formula remains in the persisted W4 domain and remains an exact R50A deadcore under full reclassification
minimality_protocol_if_deadcore_found.result_role: smaller falsifier witness only; not a proof of globally minimum size

proof_strategy_after_measurement: derive necessary structural conditions shared by every explicit hard state
form a discrete invariant candidate over reachable state plus exact provenance rather than a learned predictor
attempt a symbolic double-counting, overlap, ancestry-preservation, or obstruction-transfer lemma
remove empirical data from proof authority
prove BASE + PRESERVATION + NONTERMINAL_IMPLIES_DOOR, or exhibit a replayable deadcore
seal: CLASSIFY EVERY CLOSED DOOR EXACTLY; EITHER RETURN THE BIRD WITH A REPLAY, OR RETURN ONLY FINITE STRUCTURE AND KEEP THE THEOREM OPEN.
